title: A CMOS Integrated Capacitive Fingerprint Sensor With 32-bit RISC Microcontroller
figure_number: Fig. 2. Proposed detecting circuit of a charge-sharing scheme.
function_summary: CMOS Integrated Capacitive Fingerprint Sensor: The SOC implementation of a capacitive fingerprint sensor, which embeds the 32-bit microcontroller for performing an identification algorithm, is described for user authentication on small, thin, and portable equipment.
